newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-BLUES RE-SIGN C TURGEON TO ONE-YEAR DEAL.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-BLUES RE-SIGN C TURGEON TO ONE-YEAR DEAL.

text.p: The St Louis Blues Monday re-signed restricted free agent centre Pierre Turgeon to a one-year contract.
The 27-year-old four-time All-Star had 25 goals and 74 points in 69 games with the Blues last season after he was acquired from the Montreal Canadiens in a five-player deal on October 29.
"I am really glad to have our number one centre under contract," said Blues vice president and general manager Larry Pleau, who did not announce terms of the deal.
"Pierre decided to accept the qualifying offer, which puts him under contract for the next year."
As a Group II free agent, the Blues had the right to match any offer to Turgeon and were entitled to compensation if he signed elsewhere.
Turgeon, who has averaged 34 goals in his 10-year NHL career, was selected as a 17-year-old by the Buffalo Sabres with the first overall pick in the 1987 draft.
He enjoyed his best NHL season in 1992-93 as a member of the New York Islanders when he had 58 goals and 74 assists for 132 points in 83 games.
Turgeon has 344 goals and 520 assists for 864 points in 750 career games.
